answer_1.quote: We carried out a series of comprehensive experiments across various tasks, including question answering, summarization, and harmfulness mitigation & helpfulness enhancement.

answer_2.quote: we evaluate different methods based on two main criteria: (1) Reward Evaluation. (a) The average reward scores in the test set. (b) The reward win rate against the baseline.

answer_4.guideline: Human annotators were asked to select the best response based on specified criteria such as relevance, helpfulness, and completeness.
